## insights_rank

Rank compact period performance without returning raw insight pages. Use one entity level per call and choose an explicit conversion action and attribution window for conversion metrics. `highest` and `lowest` are numeric extremes, not automatic business judgments. `global` returns one ranking across the requested accounts; `per_account` returns one bounded ranking for each account. Add minimum evidence filters for meaningful results. The result never includes raw structured Meta metric arrays or a pagination cursor.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ad_account_ids` | array | Required |
| `date_from` | string | Required |
| `date_to` | string | Required |
| `entity_level` | campaign, adset, ad | Required |
| `rank_by` | spend, impressions, clicks, ctr, cpc, cpm, conversions, conversion_value, cpa, roas | Required |
| `action_type` | string | `"omni_purchase"` |
| `attribution_window` | value, 1d_click, 7d_click, 1d_view | `"value"` |
| `direction` | highest, lowest, both | `"both"` |
| `rank_scope` | global, per_account | `"global"` |
| `statuses` | array or null | `null` |
| `min_spend` | number or null | `null` |
| `min_impressions` | integer or null | `null` |
| `min_clicks` | integer or null | `null` |
| `min_conversions` | number or string or null | `null` |
| `limit` | integer | `5` |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "ad_account_ids": {
      "items": {
        "format": "uuid",
        "type": "string"
      },

      "type": "array"
    },
    "date_from": {
      "type": "string"

    "date_to": {
      "type": "string"

      "enum": [

        "conversion_value",
        "cpa",

      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "action_type": {
      "maxLength": 200,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string",
      "default": "omni_purchase"
    },
    "attribution_window": {
      "enum": [
        "value",
        "1d_click",
        "7d_click",
        "1d_view"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "default": "value"

    "direction": {
      "enum": [
        "highest",
        "lowest",
        "both"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "default": "both"

      "enum": [
        "global",
        "per_account"

      "type": "string",

    },
    "statuses": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "items": {
            "maxLength": 64,
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },
          "maxItems": 16,
          "type": "array"
        },

          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,

        "array",
        "null"
      ]

      "anyOf": [
        {
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "number",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "min_impressions": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "min_clicks": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "min_conversions": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "minimum": 0.0,
              "type": "number"
            },
            {
              "pattern": "^(?!^[-+.]*$)[+-]?0*\\d*\\.?\\d*$",
              "type": "string"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "number",
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "maximum": 20,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 5
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ad_account_ids",
    "date_from",
    "date_to",
    "entity_level",
    "rank_by"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

# Rule tools

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/rules

Create rules, edit their conditions, and inspect runs.

Check capabilities and current access before a write. Use the exact tool arguments below. Read results before retrying an uncertain provider operation.



## rules_schema

Return rule vocabulary; call rules_capabilities for account event values.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

**Arguments:** none.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```





## rules_list

List rules whose complete target set is readable.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | `25` |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "default": 25,
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```





## rules_get

Read the complete current rule definition for a lossless replacement.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rule_id` | uuid | Required |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "rule_id": {
      "format": "uuid",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "rule_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## rules_update

Replace one rule; first read it and preserve every unchanged field.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rule_id` | uuid | Required |
| `payload` | object | Required |

| --- | --- | --- |

| `expected_version` | integer | Required |
| `status` | string | Required |
| `request_id` | uuid | Required |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "rule_id": {
      "format": "uuid",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_version": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "request_id": {
      "format": "uuid",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },

    "rule_id",
    "expected_version",
    "status",
    "request_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

# Custom metric tools

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/custom-metrics

Create definitions, import values, check tasks, and query metrics through MCP.

Check capabilities and current access before a write. Use the exact tool arguments below. Read results before retrying an uncertain provider operation.



## custom_metrics_list

List definitions for one permitted account. Follow next_cursor until complete.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ad_account_id` | uuid | Required |
| `query` | string | `""` |
| `status` | active, archived, all | `"active"` |
| `entity_level` | account, campaign, adset, ad or null | `null` |
| `limit` | integer | `50` |
| `cursor` | string or null | `null` |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "ad_account_id": {
      "format": "uuid",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "query": {
      "default": "",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "status": {
      "default": "active",
      "enum": [
        "active",
        "archived",
        "all"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "entity_level": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "enum": [
            "account",
            "campaign",
            "adset",
            "ad"
          ],
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
```

## custom_metrics_import_prepare

Validate up to 100 complete daily values. Preview does not publish values. Use a CSV grant for larger imports.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ad_account_id` | uuid | Required |
| `idempotency_key` | string | Required |
| `rows` | array | Required |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "ad_account_id": {
      "format": "uuid",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "idempotency_key": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "rows": {
      "items": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "One complete daily value; no caller storage timestamps.",
        "properties": {
          "metric_id": {
            "format": "uuid",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "entity_level": {
            "enum": [
              "account",
              "campaign",
              "adset",
              "ad"
            ],
            "type": "string"
          },
          "entity_id": {
            "maxLength": 300,
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },
          "date": {
            "format": "date",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "value": {
            "pattern": "^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})(\\.[0-9]{1,8})?$",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "metric_id",
          "entity_level",
          "entity_id",
          "date",
          "value"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "maxItems": 100,
      "minItems": 1,
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ad_account_id",
    "idempotency_key",
    "rows"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

# Direct Meta actions

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/actions

Upload media, create or update Meta objects, duplicate setups, and change delivery status.

Check capabilities and current access before a write. Use the exact tool arguments below. Read results before retrying an uncertain provider operation.



## actions_capabilities

List configured direct Meta actions, including partial updates.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

**Arguments:** none.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {},
  "type": "object"
}
```





## media_uploads_create

Upload media to the current workspace library without requiring an account. Open a picker for up to ten files (64 MiB total by default), or supply metadata for one signed PUT grant. A successful PUT confirms library persistence. Use media_asset_id with Launcher library tools; media_id retains compatibility with creatives_create. Uploads do not contact Meta.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `payload` | object | Required |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "payload": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "Open the media picker or create one bounded signed upload grant.",
      "properties": {
        "request_id": {
          "format": "uuid",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "ad_account_id": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "format": "uuid",
              "type": "string"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "default": null
        },
        "filename": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "maxLength": 255,
              "minLength": 1,
              "type": "string"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "default": null
        },
        "mime_type": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "enum": [
                "image/jpeg",
                "image/png",
                "image/webp",
                "video/mp4",
                "video/quicktime"
              ],
              "type": "string"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "default": null
        },
        "byte_size": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "maximum": 1073741824,
              "minimum": 1,
              "type": "integer"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "default": null
        },
        "checksum_sha256": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$",
              "type": "string"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "default": null
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "request_id"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "payload"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## ads_update

Patch one existing ad. Content requires creative_policy=replace. Edits may trigger review; new content does not retain existing post engagement. Never creates a new ad. Dry run defaults true. Inspect result verification: simulation, confirmed, or reconciliation_required.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `payload` | object | Required |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.


  ```json
  {
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "payload": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Patch an existing ad; replacement creative creation must be explicit.",
        "properties": {
          "request_id": {
            "format": "uuid",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "ad_account_id": {
            "format": "uuid",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "target_id": {
            "maxLength": 300,
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },
          "changes": {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "Existing ad edits, without implicit ad or creative creation.",
            "properties": {
              "name": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "maxLength": 300,
                    "minLength": 1,
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
                ],
                "default": null
              },
              "status": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
  ```

# Activity tools

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/activity

Use the unified log for tool calls, actions, and rule operations.

Check capabilities and current access before a write. Use the exact tool arguments below. Read results before retrying an uncertain provider operation.



## activity_list

Search the complete authorized tool, action, and rule-run log. Use exact filters for known fields or `query` for case-insensitive text search across tool, action, member, target, request, and error metadata. Follow `next_cursor` until `complete` is true.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

# Memory tools

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/memory

Save facts only after an explicit request or focused approval.

Check capabilities and current access before a write. Use the exact tool arguments below. Read results before retrying an uncertain provider operation.



## memory_remember

Persist one fact after an explicit user request: remember/save/note that. A focused confirmation also counts as consent.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `payload` | object | Required |

## memory_recall

Recall bounded semantically relevant user-authored context. Prefer top-level query and optional scope (kind and target_id). Scope restricts recall to that scope only. Object and JSON-string scopes work. Alternatively supply the legacy payload; never mix the two formats. Without scope, use brand_ids/ad_account_ids and include_private/include_team.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `payload` | object or null | `null` |
| `query` | string or null | `null` |
| `scope` | object or string or null | `null` |
| `brand_ids` | array or null | `null` |
| `ad_account_ids` | array or null | `null` |
| `include_private` | boolean or null | `null` |
| `include_team` | boolean or null | `null` |
| `limit` | integer or null | `null` |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.

## launcher_collections_preview

Preview unsaved smart filters across the workspace without creating anything. Repeat the same filters and exclusions with next_cursor to continue. Results show matching creative families; launch preview checks eligible versions. Reads do not use billable Meta writes.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filter_spec` | object | Required |
| `excluded_ids` | array | `[]` |
| `limit` | integer | `24` |
| `cursor` | string or null | `null` |
| `include_count` | boolean | `true` |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json

  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "filter_spec": {
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "Versioned server filter definition.",
      "properties": {
        "schema_version": {
          "const": 1,
          "default": 1,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "conditions": {
          "default": [],
          "items": {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "description": "Conditions combine with AND; their values combine with OR.",
            "properties": {
              "schema_version": {
                "const": 1,
                "default": 1,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "field": {
                "enum": [
                  "name",
                  "concept",
                  "language",
                  "format",
                  "tags",
                  "source",
                  "imported_at"
                ],
                "type": "string"
              },
              "operator": {
                "enum": [
                  "eq",
                  "contains",
                  "in",
                  "gte",
                  "lte"
                ],
                "type": "string"
              },
              "values": {
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "maxItems": 100,
                "minItems": 1,
                "type": "array"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "field",
              "operator",
              "values"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          },
          "maxItems": 30,
          "type": "array"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "excluded_ids": {
      "default": [],
      "items": {
        "format": "uuid",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "type": "array"
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 24,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "cursor": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "maxLength": 4096,
          "type": "string"

        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,

        "string",
```

## launcher_template_versions_create

Save a new immutable template configuration version; scheduled references keep their exact version.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template_id` | uuid | Required |
| `data` | object | Required |
| `expected_version` | integer | Required |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.

## launcher_templates_archive

Archive a template identity while retaining previously pinned configuration versions.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template_id` | uuid | Required |
| `expected_version` | integer | Required |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "template_id": {
      "format": "uuid",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expected_version": {
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "template_id",
    "expected_version"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```





## launcher_media_list

List imported asset IDs and metadata; storage locations stay private.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer | `50` |
| `search` | string or null | `null` |
| `media_type` | image, video or null | `null` |
| `source_kind` | upload, google_drive or null | `null` |
| `sort` | newest, oldest, name | `"newest"` |
| `offset` | integer | `0` |
| `after_id` | uuid or null | `null` |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 100,

        "string",

      ]
    },
    "media_type": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "enum": [
            "image",
            "video"
          ],
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "source_kind": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "enum": [
            "upload",
            "google_drive"
          ],
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "sort": {
      "default": "newest",
      "enum": [
        "newest",
        "oldest",
        "name"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "offset": {
      "default": 0,
      "maximum": 100000,
      "minimum": 0,
      "type": "integer"

    "after_id": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "format": "uuid",
```

## launcher_media_delete

Archive unused media and queue storage cleanup. Retained creative or execution references block deletion.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |

# Launcher launch tools

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/launcher-launches

Discover exact provider assets and targets before preparing a launch.

Check capabilities and current access before a write. Use the exact tool arguments below. Read results before retrying an uncertain provider operation.



## launcher_promotion_sources_list

## launcher_assets_list

Find named Meta assets without copying IDs from another product. Pages, apps, pixels and audiences use the selected account. Forms, Instagram and catalogs require parent_id=Page ID. Product sets require parent_id=catalog ID plus page_id. Pages and Instagram accounts come from the synced ClickHouse catalog; inspect sync_status and synced_at for freshness. Other assets use live Meta discovery. Follow next_cursor; discovery does not guarantee launch eligibility.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ad_account_id` | uuid | Required |
| `kind` | pages, instagram_accounts, pixels, applications, lead_forms, product_catalogs, product_sets, custom_audiences | Required |
| `parent_id` | string or null | `null` |
| `page_id` | string or null | `null` |
| `limit` | integer | `50` |
| `cursor` | string or null | `null` |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "ad_account_id": {
      "format": "uuid",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "kind": {
      "description": "Supported discovery edges, never arbitrary Graph paths.",
      "enum": [
        "pages",
        "instagram_accounts",
        "pixels",
        "applications",
        "lead_forms",
        "product_catalogs",
        "product_sets",
        "custom_audiences"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "parent_id": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "pattern": "^[0-9]{1,32}$",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "page_id": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "pattern": "^[0-9]{1,32}$",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 100,
      "minimum": 1,
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "cursor": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "maxLength": 4096,
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ad_account_id",
    "kind"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## launcher_launches_submit

Submit exact inputs durably using one stable request key; effects run asynchronously. Pin selection.creative_versions pairs for saved-version choice; manual_groups.creative_version_ids assign those exact versions independently. Another saved version requires no retest reason; reusing the same confirmed version needs retest_reason. Reserved or uncertain usage cannot be retested. Corrected failed items require replacement metadata, pinned saved versions, an exact existing target and a new request key.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | object | Required |

## launcher_launches_retry

Retry unchanged inputs after no-write proof. Use attempt 0 for every untouched operation after a failed preflight; uncertainty stays blocked.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ad_account_id` | uuid | Required |
| `launch_id` | uuid | Required |
| `expected_version` | integer | Required |
| `expected_attempts` | object | Required |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.

```json
    "ad_account_id": {
      "format": "uuid",
      "type": "string"

      "format": "uuid",

      "type": "integer"

      "propertyNames": {

}
```

## launcher_source_details_get

Read normalized source settings and a page of ads before cloning or editing. Follow next_cursor to enumerate all source ads. Unknown fields are explicit; source metadata never grants access to reusable media or live eligibility.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `ad_account_id` | uuid | Required |
| `adset_id` | string | Required |
| `campaign_id` | string or null | `null` |

| `cursor` | string or null | `null` |

# Launcher schedules and limits

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/launcher-schedules

Create recurring launches and set account campaign and budget limits.

Check capabilities and current access before a write. Use the exact tool arguments below. Read results before retrying an uncertain provider operation.

# Launcher Drive tools

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/reference/launcher-drive

Authorize Google Drive and select files or folders in Superlaunch first.

Check capabilities and current access before a write. Use the exact tool arguments below. Read results before retrying an uncertain provider operation.

## launcher_drive_folders_save

Save a folder selected in Superlaunch's Google Picker with drive.file. Folder selection grants no access to its children. Select each new media batch in Google Picker, then refresh the folder list. No automatic import starts.

**Access:** `mcp:read` and `mcp:write`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection_id` | uuid | Required |
| `folder_id` | string | Required |
| `protected_manifest_ref` | uuid or null | `null` |

```json
      "type": "string"
    },

      "anyOf": [
        {
          "format": "uuid",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "connection_id",
    "folder_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```





## launcher_drive_folder_files_list

List up to 100 selected media files and folders with drive.file. This is a selected subset: an empty page does not mean the folder is empty. Select each new batch in Superlaunch's Google Picker, then refresh this tool. Follow next_page_token for more authorized items; no complete-folder claim or automatic monitoring is made. Child navigation verifies saved-root ancestry. Protected references expire after one hour. Files are not downloaded.

**Access:** `mcp:read`. Workspace and target permissions also apply.

| Parameter | Type | Required / default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection_id` | uuid | Required |
| `folder_id` | string | Required |
| `parent_folder_id` | string or null | `null` |
| `parent_manifest_ref` | uuid or null | `null` |
| `search` | string | `""` |
| `media_type` | all, image, video | `"all"` |
| `page_token` | string or null | `null` |

Keep the argument nesting shown in the schema. Expand it for nested fields, allowed values, and limits.



```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "connection_id": {
      "format": "uuid",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "folder_id": {
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,200}$",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "parent_folder_id": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,200}$",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "parent_manifest_ref": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "format": "uuid",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "search": {
      "default": "",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "media_type": {
      "default": "all",
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "image",
        "video"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "page_token": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "maxLength": 4096,
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "default": null,
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "connection_id",
    "folder_id"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

# Billing and usage

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/support/billing

Review the workspace subscription, usage, payments, and access state.

The workspace owner manages billing. Open **Billing** to review the subscription, plan limits, usage, and payments.

## Plans and trials

Check the [pricing page](https://superlaunch.pro/pricing) for current plans. Before starting a subscription, review the workspace, price, billing interval, trial terms, and taxes in checkout.

After checkout, return to **Billing** and check the subscription status. If it stays pending, refresh the page or [contact support](https://superlaunch.pro/contact) before starting another checkout.

## Usage

Review your allowance and recorded usage in **Billing**. Launcher previews estimate usage; Superlaunch records usage after it confirms changes in Meta. If a limit blocks a launch, review the message and your allowance before trying again.

## Manage your subscription and payments

Use **Manage subscription** to review plan changes or **Cancel subscription** to cancel. Check the effective date before confirming a change.

Open **Payments** for payment activity. Select **View invoices and manage billing** to open the payment provider's billing portal.

If the page shows **Test mode**, no real payments are processed.

## Restore access

A billing issue can restrict new work. The owner should check the status in **Billing** and follow the displayed recovery steps. Other members should contact the owner.

For payment help or refund questions, use [Contact](https://superlaunch.pro/contact) and the [refund policy](https://superlaunch.pro/refund.html).

# Troubleshooting

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/support/troubleshooting

Resolve common workspace, reporting, rule, and launch problems.

Start with the exact workspace, account, date range, and operation you were using.

## Sign-in or workspace access

Complete any email-verification step. If the workspace is missing, confirm that you accepted its invitation with the same email identity. Ask the owner to check membership.

A billing access message needs a billing-state check by the owner. See [Billing and usage](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/support/billing).

## Connected account has no data

Check account selection, provider permissions, member access, and the reporting period. The first import can still be running. An account without delivery in the selected period can have an empty report.

If the provider authorization needs renewal, open **Connections → Ad platforms** and reconnect it.

## Report values differ from Meta

Compare the entity level, account time zone, currency, conversion event, attribution window, report grain, and breakdown. Check the data-through date and whether the complete result set has loaded.

A daily report and a period ranking answer different questions. Keep the query definitions together when comparing them.

## Rule did not change an object

Check the rule status, dry-run setting, schedule, current version, target filter, and task conditions. Inspect the run and activity records for skipped targets or errors. A dry run can record decisions without changing provider state.

## Launch partially failed

Read individual operation results. Retry eligible unchanged work or prepare a corrected replacement. Avoid submitting the entire successful and failed set again. See [Recover a launch](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/launcher/recovery).

## Contact support

Send the approximate time, workspace name, tool or feature, and activity or run ID through [Contact](https://superlaunch.pro/contact). Include the error code and expected outcome. Do not include access tokens or signed private URLs.

# Glossary

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/reference/glossary

Definitions for the terms used in Superlaunch and its MCP tools.

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Workspace | Team context for members, connections, billing, and shared content |
| Provider connection | Authorization that lets Superlaunch access an advertising platform |
| MCP connection | Authorization that lets an AI client use Superlaunch on your behalf |
| Ad account | Provider account with its own currency, time zone, and assets |
| Campaign | Meta object that defines a campaign objective and related settings |
| Ad set | Meta object with targeting, optimization, delivery, and ads |
| Ad | Delivery object that uses a creative |
| Brand kit | Versioned positioning, voice, colors, fonts, and proof points |
| Memory | A saved fact available to later conversations within its chosen scope |
| Creative family | Workspace library object containing saved content versions |
| Creative version | Exact content, format, language, and media saved at one point |
| Saved draft | Immutable creative content eligible for current launch checks without a separate approval step |
| Collection | Fixed selection or smart filter over library creatives |
| Template version | Saved settings for campaign, ad-set, budget, and naming behavior |
| Launch | Submitted batch of work with saved settings and operation results |
| Schedule | Configuration for recurring launch or rule execution |
| Rule | Targeted conditions and actions with scheduling settings |
| Dry run | A check of inputs or rule decisions without making live changes in Meta |
| Activity | Permission-filtered record of a tool call, action, or rule operation |
| Idempotent retry | Replay of the same intended operation with the same key and inputs |
| Minor units | Smallest currency denomination; an amount of `1000` minor units means USD $10.00 |
| Attribution window | Reporting interval used to count an event after an ad interaction |
| Cursor | Token or offset for the next page of a filtered result |

# Documentation for AI assistants

Source: https://docs.superlaunch.pro/reference/ai-access

Read the public documentation index, full text, and page Markdown.

Use these public files to give an AI assistant the Superlaunch documentation.

| Resource | URL | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Product index | [superlaunch.pro/llms.txt](https://superlaunch.pro/llms.txt) | Product links and capability summaries |
| Full product text | [superlaunch.pro/llms-full.txt](https://superlaunch.pro/llms-full.txt) | Expanded product capabilities and limits |
| Documentation index | [/llms.txt](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/llms.txt?v=20261020) | Page titles, descriptions, and links |
| Full documentation | [/llms-full.txt](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/llms-full.txt?v=20261020) | Combined documentation content |
| Page Markdown | Add `.md` to a page URL, for example [/mcp/overview.md](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/overview.md) | Text for one page |

Both documentation text files come from the checked page source. The index lists page titles, descriptions, and links. The full-text file contains all public navigation pages and the exact MCP input schemas. Use the index to choose pages for a question; use the full-text file when you need the complete site.

## Example prompt

> Read [https://docs.superlaunch.pro/llms.txt?v=20261020](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/llms.txt?v=20261020) and the linked MCP setup guide. Explain how to connect Superlaunch in my client, then wait for me to finish authorization before reading my accounts.

## Public docs and private workspace data

These public files describe Superlaunch. To read your advertising data or change campaigns, [connect the product MCP server](https://docs.superlaunch.pro/mcp/connect) and authorize access to your workspace.
